name: mobilede-mcp
description: mobile.de (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_mobilede_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MOBILEDE_USERNAME
platform_mcp_mobilede_username.description: Username of a mobile.de API account (Search-API / Ad-Integration access is activated by mobile.de customer support); HTTP Basic.

platform_mcp_mobilede_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MOBILEDE_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_mobilede_password.description: Password of that API account (HTTP Basic).

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: GET https://services.mobile.de/search-api/search (Accept: application/vnd.de.mobile.api+json). make is mobile.de's make key (e.g. AUDI, BMW → classification=refdata/classes/Car/makes/<make>); model is matched as modelDescription text; year_min/year_max filter the first registration (YYYY-01 … YYYY-12); location is the seller's ISO-3166 country code (e.g. DE, AT). mobile.de rejects searches carrying only numeric filters, so give make, model, condition or location. At most 2,000 ads are reachable per query (page.size ≤ 100). `query` is not used (no free-text parameter). price.consumerPriceGross (a decimal string, EUR) and firstRegistration (YYYYMM) stay in raw.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET https://services.mobile.de/search-api/ad/{ad-key} (the mobileAdId): the full ad, richer than a search row; price.consumerPriceGross (decimal string, EUR), firstRegistration, seller and images stay in raw. 404 for a wrong ad-key.
